scope: Predeclared Stage-1 B-ladder seed-confirmation side study for the JointMoE x1 main-grid prescription

seeds.training_seed_scope: model initialization and deterministic training-data ordering; corpus membership, tokenizer, language mixture, and held-out validation remain fixed

baseline_reuse.reuse_policy: consume the nine canonical seed-1234 B trajectories after their hash-valid receipts complete; never recompute them for this side study

frozen_factors: JointMoE x1 learning-rate law and WSD schedule
optimizer, batch ramp, precision, routing, and checkpoint horizons
sealed corpus, tokenizer, language maps, and alpha-0.3 sampling policy
held-out per-language validation corpus and adjusted-loss definition

analysis_contract.replication_unit: independent training seed within a fixed E/K cell
required_reporting: per-cell and per-readout mean, sample standard deviation, and range across the three seeds
seed-wise E32-minus-E1 and K200-minus-K1 contrasts at matched cells
whether the qualitative E and K conclusions are directionally stable across seeds
analysis_contract.significance_policy: three seeds provide bounded descriptive robustness evidence; do not turn checkpoints, readouts, or language rows into independent seed replicates
forbidden_claims: statistical significance inferred from nested readouts or language rows
